# Chabod Cleaning Services

> Family-owned cleaning company in San Antonio, TX, founded 2018.
> Services: short-term rental (Airbnb/VRBO) turnover cleaning, residential
> house cleaning, and deep cleaning.

## Services
- [STR/Airbnb Turnover Cleaning](https://chabodcleaningservices.com/str-cleaning): Same-day turnover cleaning (subject to availability) for Airbnb and VRBO hosts in San Antonio.
- [Residential House Cleaning](https://chabodcleaningservices.com/residential-cleaning): Recurring and one-time house cleaning with a consistent assigned team.
- [Deep Cleaning](https://chabodcleaningservices.com/deep-cleaning): Detailed deep cleaning covering grout, baseboards, and appliances.

## Free tools
- [Airbnb and Vrbo Fee Change Calculator](https://chabodcleaningservices.com/tools/fee-calculator): Free calculator for San Antonio short-term rental hosts. Enter a nightly rate and cleaning fee to see the new price that keeps your payout after Airbnb's 15.5% host fee (Sept 15, 2026) and Vrbo's 12% commission (Oct 29, 2026). Add ?platform=vrbo to open it on Vrbo.
